respondent:
C.B.I.
Supreme Court of India

2 December 2014
Cr.A. No. 346 of 2004
The Judgment was delivered by : Adarsh Kumar Goel, J.
1. This appeal has been preferred u/s. 10 of the Special Court (Trial of Offences relating to Transactions in Securities) Act, 1992 (for short "the Special Court") against the Judgment and Order dated 20th January, 2004 passed by the Special Court constituted under the said Act in Special Case No.1 of 1997 in R.C. No.9 (BSC)/94/BOM.
2. In the wake of report of enquiry committee constituted by the Reserve Bank of India under the Chairmanship of Shri Janki Raman to enquire into the allegation of unauthorized diversion of public funds belonging to certain public sector banks and financial institutions by employees of such banks and institutions in collusion with some brokers, the Act was enacted for constitution of a Special Court for trial of criminal offences in respect of transactions during the period 1st April, 1991 to 6th June, 1992 a
holding: The offences of conspiracy, forgery, misappropriation and corruption stand established.
In view of above, we are unable to interfere with the conviction of the appellant. The same is affirmed.
